IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated: Nainital: the 20th day of May, 2008
Miscellaneous Application No.966 of 2008
IN
CRIMINAL IIND BAIL APPLICATION NO.1385 OF 2007
Order on the Bail application of accused.
CRIMINAL SIDE
Ajiz S/o Nasru R/o Vill.Majahidpur,
Satiwala Majbata, P.S. Buggawala, Distt. Hardwar
 Applicant (In Jail)
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand -------- Opposite party
_______________________________________________
Arising out of Case Crime No.19 of 2007,
U/Ss 420/467/468/471 IPC, P.S. Buggawala, Distt. Hardwar
Honíble Dharam Veer, J.
 This is the second bail application moved by the
applicant. The first bail application was dismissed as not
pressed by this Court on 4.12.2007 and that was not
dismissed on merit.
 Heard Sri S.P.S. Panwar, learned senior counsel
assisted by Sri Sachin Panwar, learned counsel for the
applicant and Sri Harish Pujari, learned Addl. G.A. for the
State as well as Sri Mohd. Safdar, learned counsel for the
complainant.
 In brief, the prosecution case is that complainant Smt.
Wahidan had executed a sale deed in favour of the present
applicant on 7.4.2007 and the sale deed was registered in
the office of Sub-Ragistrar, Roorkee on 9.5.2007. The
complainant Wahidan lodged the FIR with the allegations
that she is a blind lady and she had executed a will in
favour of a mosque on 1.10.1996 but the sale deed was
executed in favour of the applicant by defrauding her by

taking benefit that she is blind lady. The said FIR was
lodged in the Police Station Buggawala, Distt. Hardwar on
20.7.2007 at 11:10 A.M.
 Learned senior counsel for the applicant submitted
that the complainant Wahidan also filed a civil suit for the
cancellation of the above sale deed in the court of Civil
Judge (Junior Division) Roorkee on 30.4.2007 and the FIR
against the present applicant was lodged on 20.07.2007. He
further submitted that on the basis of sale deed, mutation
proceedings had also taken place in the revenue records in
favour of the present applicant by the order of Competent
Court dated 29.9.2007. The copy of the civil suit has been
annexed as Annexure SA3 to the supplementary affidavit;
copy of order of mutation dated 29.9.2007 has been
annexed as Annexure SA1 to the supplementary affidavit
and copy of sale deed has been annexed as Annexure SA2
to the supplementary affidavit filed by the applicant. It was
further submitted that the matter is purely civil in nature
and the civil suit is also pending in the court of Civil Judge
(Junior Division) Roorkee for cancellation of the said sale
deed. He further submitted that the applicant has got no
criminal history before this case and at present, applicant
is the owner of the said land and he has been detained in
jail since October, 2007 and the trial of the case has yet not
been started.
 After considering all the facts and circumstances of
the case, without expressing any opinion about the final
merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant
deserves bail at this stage.
 Let applicant Ajiz be released on bail on his executing
personal bond and furnishing two sureties each in the like
amount to the satisfaction of CJM, Hardwar.
 The bail application is disposed of accordingly.
 (Dharam Veer, J.)
20th May, 2008:
Rajeev Dang
